title: FLA import: Scene 5 mask drops 'Ball' masked child (mask before child in bottom-to-top binary)
description:
FIXED (task 1341). Root cause: the CPicLayer trailer parentReference (docs/21 §10.2) was only ever consumed as a 2-byte peek and resolveMaskedLayers() did a single FORWARD scan that promoted only the consecutive run of children stored AFTER (above, higher binary index than) the mask, requiring equal non-zero refs. In Scene 5 ('Page 5') the mask 'Layer 5' (bin 2) has TWO masked children on OPPOSITE sides in the bottom-to-top binary: the masked 'Layer 5' (bin 3, parentRef=17=mask running object index, raw form) AND 'Ball' (bin 1, parentRef=0x8003 = CArchive BACKREF-tag form). The forward scan never looked before the mask, so 'Ball' stayed type=normal and rendered un-masked. (AA happens to store all 3 children AFTER the mask, so it worked and magnet-inspect only covered AA.)

Decode (verified by raw probe of Pages 1/5/6/7/8 via parseFla8Timeline + ownObjectIndex): a masked child's parentReference is a §5.2 running object index of its mask, in two forms — RAW (== mask.ownObjectIndex; the children above the mask) or BACKREF-tagged 0x8000|n (the one child directly below the mask; literal index is a backref to an earlier shared object, not the mask).

FIX: (1) flash8-binary.ts: expose ArchiveReader.nextObjectIndex and stamp each Fla8Layer with ownObjectIndex (captured when its class tag is consumed). (2) flash8-import.ts resolveMaskedLayers(): order-independent two-pass — index masks by ownObjectIndex; promote any normal layer whose raw parentRef == a mask's ownObjectIndex, OR whose parentRef has the 0x8000 backref bit AND the nearest mask above is adjacent (i+1). (3) convertTimeline() reorder block: gather masked children from BOTH the pre-mask tail and the post-mask run and re-emit [mask, ...masked] so the model invariant (mask above contiguous masked children) holds for children that were on either side.

VERIFY: tryLoadRealFla(Magnet.fla).scenes[1] now = li0 'Layer 5' mask / li1 'Layer 5' masked / li2 'Ball' masked / li3 'Layer 3' normal (Ball restored). AA unchanged at the asserted level (Magnets/Walls/Ball masked, mask 'Layer 5'; AA's 'Layer 3' is now also correctly masked as the symmetric backref child). Regression test added: magnet-inspect.test.ts 'scene 5 (scene 1) mask clips BOTH Layer 5 and Ball (task 1341)' — order-independent (both masked, Layer 3 normal, mask above contiguous masked children). pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green. @flash/core: 5518 passed; only the 3 pre-existing flash8-empty.fla missing-fixture failures (carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch — fixture never committed to git, environmental, allowed). @flash/swf: 1468 passed. magnet-inspect: 5/5.
